_schema.hierarchy: toy ICD-10 WHO hierarchy used by every example (SPEC 1.2)
_schema.presets: named configs; a config is either a full mapping or {'preset': name, ...overrides}
_schema.evidence: one medication response: {'model_version', 'entities': [{'id','type','score','traits': [[name, score]], 'concepts': [[code, score]]}]} in array order
_schema.variants: optional {'factor': 'std'|'alt'}; missing means 'std'; only the (factor, level) pairs listed in SPEC 4.3 have an 'alt'
_schema.family: list of sets (lists) of factor names; compare as a set of frozensets
_schema.space: 'CM' or 'WHO'; WHO keys use the SPEC 1.2 projection who_exact_fb for cm_* outputs
_schema.kinds: projection, presence, equality, run, trait_rules, family, dummy, bfs, identification, backing, profiles, output_validation, scoring, metrics, holm, zero_event, ni_pvalue
